messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI alert: audit-event-validator failed on master after the KMS metadata change. Failing test: golden_fixture_roundtrip_test.
eli: saw that, digging in. CI log shows schema mismatch: validator expects `kms_key_uri` but fixtures still have `key_id` in metadata.
sanjay: is that the PR that switched to canonical KMS URIs (projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/...) ?
maya: yes, #5124 introduced that. Local run: `pytest tests/audit/ -k golden_fixture_roundtrip_test -q` reproduces it.
eli: quick snippet from validator error: 
```
ValidationError: metadata.kms_key_uri: missing required field
  at audit_validator.py:142
```

frances: audit-ci-bot posted the failure too. It shows the fixture that failed contains `key_id: "us-west-2:abc123"` instead of `kms_key_uri`.
eli: we have two options: make validator accept legacy `key_id` during transition, or migrate golden fixtures to new schema. Prefer to make validator backward-compatible with a deprecation warning, then update fixtures in a follow-up.
sanjay: agree. If we change validator it should detect `key_id` and internally normalize to `kms_key_uri` so downstream checks are stable. Add an FIXME to remove normalization after 6 weeks.
maya: quick patch idea: in `normalize_metadata()` do: `if 'key_id' in metadata and 'kms_key_uri' not in metadata: metadata['kms_key_uri'] = to_canonical_uri(metadata.pop('key_id'))` — need to implement `to_canonical_uri` mapping for old formats.
eli: caution: some `key_id` values are region-prefixed strings used by the old on-prem KMS shim. We need to ensure mapping doesn't leak non-canonical values. I'll add a sanitizer that rejects unknown shapes and surfaces them to failures with a clear error message.
frances: CI rerun requested: `audit-ci-bot: /rerun 2046789012`
audit-ci-bot: Rerun queued for golden_fixture_roundtrip_test (builder: linux-py3.11).
ops-oncall: FYI — this is customer-visible: some customers upload audit events using older SDKs that emit `key_id`. We should avoid breaking ingestion.
sanjay: good point. That means the validator change is the right short-term fix. But we still must update golden fixtures to reflect canonical URIs to prevent future confusion.
maya: I'll put up a small PR that adds normalization + unit tests for the mapping and a deprecation log. Target: patch branch `hotfix/audit-kms-compat`.
eli: also add a CI-only check that scans fixtures for any `key_id` occurrences. Fail CI if found and point to the migration script. That will prevent regressions.
frances: can we add a migration script `tools/migrate-fixtures-kms.py` that rewrites fixtures in place with backups? Something like: 
```
python tools/migrate-fixtures-kms.py --dir tests/fixtures/golden --dry-run
```

maya: yes, will include that in the follow-up commit. Plan: (1) hotfix validator normalization + tests, (2) migration script + run locally, (3) update golden fixtures and push, (4) remove normalization after 6 weeks.
eli: also add an update to CHANGELOG and a short note in release playbook to notify integrations that old SDKs will be deprecated.
sanjay: for the hotfix please include an explicit mapping table for known legacy `key_id` formats we observed (regex → canonical pattern). That avoids ad-hoc heuristics.
maya: working on the PR now. Will @mention infra if we need KMS access to validate real URIs.
ops-oncall: if anything hits prod ingestion during the change window we'll open a Slack incident channel and escalate.
frances: CI rerun finished: audit-ci-bot: Rerun succeeded for linux-py3.11 but some unrelated flake in coverage job. Main validator test now passes with normalization in local run.
eli: great — once PR is up please request a quick review from @sanjay and @frances. Then merge to canary and roll to prod with canary sampling.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5178 — includes normalizer + tests + deprecation log entry.
sanjay: reviewing now. Small nit: add an explicit log line `logger.warning("legacy key_id used; normalized to kms_key_uri — remove after 6 weeks")` so audit teams can find occurrences.
maya: adding that. Will also add unit test for anonymized mapping for on-prem values.
frances: created follow-up ticket: SEC-1223 (update golden fixtures + migration + docs).
eli: once fixtures are migrated, let's also add an automated CI gate that prevents new fixtures with legacy fields.
maya: noted. Merging hotfix after approvals, then schedule fixture migration in SEC-1223. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: marking this thread for incident watch if we see any ingestion errors in next 48h.
frances: closing loop — will post postmortem if we observe customer impact.
maya: thanks — will monitor.
